name: Check CRM database availability
description: Call this when you need to confirm the CRM module is provisioned for the signed-in account and obtain the organization id that CRM-scoped calls belong to, before loading deals, tasks, or other CRM data. It is a lightweight readiness probe, not a source of account detail — use the organization details action for name, plan, or settings, and the CRM plan info action for CRM entitlements.
preconditions: A signed-in Brevo web session whose credentials are sent to crm-backend-api.brevo.com.
The account has access to the CRM module.

organization_id.description: Identifier of the organization whose CRM database backs the session; used to scope subsequent CRM requests.
